data.title: Pi extension/shim: gwl-agents GitHub App identity for ephemeral agents
data.description:
DR 0011: ephemeral Pi agents use the gwl-agents GitHub App class identity. They need a way to run gh/git as gwl-agents[bot] without mutating Grey's stored gh auth.

Scope:
- A Pi extension if the extension API supports env/spawn hooks; otherwise a small shim directory prepended to PATH for agent subprocesses.
- Mint/refresh GitHub App installation access tokens (they expire ~1 hour) using the gwl-agents app credentials; never store a static GH_TOKEN in config.
- Inject GH_TOKEN per agent process, plus GH_CONFIG_DIR isolation if needed, and git author/committer env for gwl-agents[bot] once the renamed bot id/email is re-discovered.
- Respect the tightened permission set Grey configured (review-first + the two extras); document that Contents:write means agents can push on unprotected repos.
- Acceptance: an ephemeral Pi code-review subagent can post a PR review as gwl-agents[bot]; gh auth status as Grey remains unchanged outside the agent process.

Context: hearth DR 0011 (GitHub identity) and tmp/github-identity-spike-2026-08-15.md.

data.title: Multiple gwl-agents GitHub Apps: per-agent identities so parallel reviews don't collapse
data.description:
Problem: parallel review agents (the multi-review skill) all post to GitHub as the single `gwl-agents` app. GitHub computes `reviewDecision` from the latest review per reviewer *identity*, so all agents collapse into one reviewer and the last review wins — a later APPROVE from one agent silently overrides an earlier CHANGES_REQUESTED from another, hiding blocking findings in the aggregate badge.

Observed 2026-09-09 on gwl-job-tools PRs #19/#21/#22: deepseek-v4-pro posted CHANGES_REQUESTED, glm-5.3-flash posted APPROVED seconds later, and the PR's reviewDecision flipped to APPROVED even though the blocking review is still in the review list.

Improvement:
- Provision one GitHub App per agent identity (e.g. gwl-agents-arch / -logic / -sec, or per-model), each installed on the same repos with the same tightened permission set.
- Extend the gh-app wrapper (or the GWLA-fi1m8w shim) to select the app identity per agent (env var / flag / per-agent config), so each parallel reviewer posts under a distinct identity.
- Update the gh-app skill: document identity selection and the "one identity per agent" rule.
- Update the multi-review skill: external-PR workflow should have each reviewer post its own review under its own identity (or explicitly document that the build agent posts a single consolidated review), and note the reviewDecision last-wins caveat.
- Update global agent instructions (AGENTS.md) if they reference the single-app rule.

Acceptance: two parallel agents posting different verdicts on the same PR produce a reviewDecision that reflects the blocking verdict (a CHANGES_REQUESTED is not overridden by a later APPROVE from a different identity).

Related: GWLA-fi1m8w (single-app shim — the foundation this builds on).
